description: Weighted anomaly-risk index with an evidence-first action table for MIA Plati Instant payments (MDL). Scores are anomaly/context indices, not fraud probabilities.

mia_limits.notes: Personal limits follow BNM/bank terms for MIA (5,000 MDL per transaction, 10,000 per day, 30,000 per month at bank level). Business P2B/B2B payments are not bound by the P2P cap; 100,000 MDL per transaction and 1,000,000 MDL per day are documented generator assumptions.

families.velocity: Unusually intense transfer velocity for this sender
families.amount_deviation: Material deviation from the sender's own recent amounts
families.compromised_access: Device or session change accompanied by recent authentication failures
families.beneficiary_risk: New beneficiary that other accounts started paying at the same time
families.funds_flow: Recently received funds being passed straight on to a new beneficiary
families.limit_pressure: Payments pressing against the MIA per-transaction or daily limit
families.identity_change: The sender's phone alias was rebound to a new SIM or device shortly before
families.payment_instrument: The payment instrument itself is suspicious (unknown Request-to-Pay requester, QR naming another merchant)
